book_meta.work: short stories by Guy de Maupassant and Anton Chekhov
book_meta.author: Maupassant (d. 1893) and Chekhov (d. 1904)
book_meta.status: public domain — retold from the plots, not from any translation

sentences.ar: مرا حلوة كانت متجوزة موظف بسيط.
sentences.en: A beautiful woman was married to a modest clerk.

sentences.ar: كانت تحلم بحياة تانية طول الوقت.
sentences.en: She dreamed of another life all the time.
Her husband brought an invitation to a great party.
She said: I have nothing to wear.

sentences.ar: صرف عليها كل اللي كان مجمعه.
sentences.en: He spent on her everything he had saved.

sentences.ar: واستعارت عقد ألماس من صاحبتها الغنية.
sentences.en: And she borrowed a diamond necklace from her wealthy friend.

sentences.ar: بالحفلة، كانت أحلى وحدة، ورقصت لآخر الليل.
sentences.en: At the party, she was the loveliest there, and danced till the night’s end.

sentences.ar: وهي راجعة، اكتشفت إن العقد ضاع.
sentences.en: On the way back, she discovered the necklace was gone.

sentences.ar: استلفوا مصاري كتيرة واشتروا عقد مثله.
sentences.en: They borrowed a great deal of money and bought one like it.

sentences.ar: عشر سنين اشتغلت خدامة تسدد الدين.
sentences.en: For ten years she worked as a maid to pay the debt.

sentences.ar: يدينها خشنت ووجهها كبر قبل وقته.
sentences.en: Her hands grew rough and her face aged before its time.
One day, she met her friend in the street.

sentences.ar: حكت لها كل إشي وهي فخورة إنها سددت.
sentences.en: She told her everything, proud that she had paid it off.

sentences.ar: صاحبتها قالت لها: بس عقدي كان مقلد.
sentences.en: Her friend said to her: but my necklace was false.
